description: Implementation of the PersonService interface providing CRUD operations for Person entities, integrating with the PersonRepository and handling transactions and exceptions.

classes.name: PersonServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing PersonService; handles CRUD operations for Person entities, uses Spring annotations for service and transaction management.

methods.name: fetchPersonsByPages
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Person objects based on page number and size.

methods.name: getPersonById
methods.description: Fetches a Person by its ID, throws PersonNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: addPerson
methods.description: Saves a new Person entity to the repository.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing Person entity identified by ID with data from provided Person object.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person entity by ID after fetching it.
